contentText: As the 2025 Africa Cup of Nations nears its conclusion, with Morocco set to face Senegal in the final on Sunday, FRANCE 24 speaks to Leslie Koroma Sr., CEO of Africa Sports Ventures Group, to reflect on the tournament and its spotlight on local talent. Noting that all four semi-finalist teams were coached by locals, Koroma described this as a "sea change" for the sport, highlighting the growing emphasis on developing homegrown talent.
